snippet.title: Dyrus
snippet.description:
I play video games, League of Legend and other games

Variety content will go to my 2nd youtube channel that you can find at: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCsErcOWwuCk5osdsbDvjOnQ

watch my videos in 1.25x speed I talk slow

I am a retired League of Legends pro that is now an aspiring youtuber/streamer.

League Content will be uploaded every 3-6 days usually 

If you would like to support me just follow me on social media or give me feedback!

We have several editors now that you can find in the description of each video
